title: The Power of Awareness: Overcoming Surveillance Capitalism
summary: A presentation exploring how individual awareness can serve as a defense mechanism against surveillance capitalism, examining how tech companies exploit user data and offering strategies for reclaiming digital privacy through mindful technology use.
problem_solved: Addresses the systemic privacy exploitation where tech companies harvest and monetize personal data without meaningful user consent.
why_valuable: Empowers individuals with awareness and practical tools to protect their digital privacy in an era of ubiquitous data collection.
